environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'shared-services' on GKE cluster. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service and accessible from any pod in the cluster. No Istio sidecar injection is configured for the namespace. Network policies are set to allow-all within the cluster. The service is called by frontend pods in 'web-app' namespace and by batch processing pods in 'jobs' namespace.
